At the start of your turn ( or when you examine a card in a location deck) ( or when you defeat a monster), you may replace your character and token with Aric's. Then you may exchange a card in your hand with a card in your kit.
 | 
On your check that invokes the Finesse trait, you gain the skill Melee: Dexterity +3.
 | 
At the end of your move step ( or turn), you may examine the top card of your location deck. ( If it is a monster, you may encounter it.)
 | 
 On your combat check, you may discard ( or recharge) a card that has the Accessory or Clothing trait or an armor to add 1d8 ( 1d12).
 | 
 If a character at your location would fail a check to defeat a monster ( or a barrier), you may discard a card to allow her to reroll the dice and take the new result.
 | 
 When a villain escapes, you may move to a new location that was neither closed nor temporarily closed.
